standardization: Within-season candidate-pool z scores except exponential availability, PPG rank and WS48 rank curve terms, which are uncentered raw curve values.
standings: Conference and league rank by final regular-season win percentage; normalized to 0-1; ties averaged; playoff seed and play-in results excluded
validation_warning: 2016-2026 results previously inspected; retrospective comparison, not a fresh untouched test.
selection: User-requested qualified PPG and WS/48 top-five penalties; existing model inputs and settings retained.
availability: Strictly negative fitted weight times expm1(log(2) * shortfall / (0.10 * team_games)) / (log(2) / (0.10 * team_games)). shortfall=max(0, ceil(0.85*team_games)-G). Zero above threshold; marginal cost doubles each extra 10% season shortfall.
expectations: Preseason win-total market line scaled to actual team games / planned preseason schedule; actual wins minus scaled expected wins. Coefficient constrained nonnegative. Pre-2003 training seasons are neutral; aggregate-team rows use season-pool median inputs.
rank_penalties: For qualified rank R and qualified leaderboard count N, d=max(0,R-5), r=log(2)/(0.10*N); penalty=negative fitted weight * expm1(r*d)/r. Zero through fifth; marginal cost doubles each further 10% of qualified field. Unqualified players remain excluded.
